Keppel Corp Ltd v Sembcorp Marine Ltd [2024] SGCA 15

CA/CA 50/2023
2024-05-10
Court of Appeal
Sundaresh Menon CJ, Andrew Phang Boon Leong JCA, Judith Prakash JCA
Mr Davinder Singh SC for the Appellant; Mr Alvin Yeo SC for the Respondent
Keppel Corp Ltd; Sembcorp Marine Ltd
Companies — Directors — Duties
Contract — Formation — Offer and Acceptance

Background

1 This appeal concerns the merger agreement between two major Singapore-listed companies.

2 The core dispute is whether the board of Keppel Corp breached its fiduciary duties in approving the merger terms under section 157 of the Companies Act (Cap 50, 2006 Rev Ed).

Majority Judgment (Menon CJ and Phang JCA)

3 We hold that the directors did not breach their fiduciary duties. The business judgment rule as articulated in ECRC Land Pte Ltd v Wing On Ho Christopher [2004] 1 SLR(R) 105 applies.

4 The appeal is allowed. The High Court's order is set aside.

Dissenting Judgment (Prakash JCA)

5 With respect, I disagree with the majority. In my view, the directors failed to discharge the duty of care required under Howard Smith Ltd v Ampol Petroleum Ltd [1974] AC 821.

6 I would have dismissed the appeal.

Orders

7 By majority, the appeal is allowed. Costs of the appeal fixed at $80,000 inclusive of disbursements to the appellant.
